source_verification.scope: Original animation and content slots physically extracted. Source study previews and prior compiled-source static renders are separate from new-content application verification.
source_verification.new_content_scope: 三个文本绑定且原生时序逐字节保持；不是整稿美化或任意外部接页已验收。

native_visual_metrics.cycle_scope: The XML duration is a source field; MAE at nominal times is diagnostic only. Use observed flow reversals to confirm the actual target-software return and next-cycle start. Arbitrary leave/reentry and endless runtime are unverified.

new_content_call.review_method: All stable states and dense temporal sheets of every boundary; complete file decoded. These artifacts are not an independent full real-time human watch.
new_content_call.visual_review_scope: 原模板两列各5图反向运动、返程及后续一程，三个文本绑定；完整录像已解码并对照时序图。字体主标题很浅，为原模板样式，整页美化与整稿接口未签收。
new_content_call.flow_limitations: 固定ROI跨过斜列边界时会混合两列方向；KLT数值仅诊断，未用作精确周期秒表。

scope: 历史实播记录摘要；不包含原录像或截图。新稿须另行实播。
